A friendly update, this weekend
A focused stint is easier with a plan
Travelers, please check your pet booking details before you head to the airport.

Pet Travel Notes
We are keeping the process steady and humane for every animal in our care. <<FACT F072>> Please make sure crates are secure, clean, and ready for staff review, and keep your paperwork close at hand.

If you are bringing a larger companion, our team will guide you through the steps and confirm what applies at the desk. <<FACT F057>> Give your pet a calm start, and let us help with the rest so the trip stays smooth for everyone.

For final checks and any last details, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
